newsitem.title: CHINA: China launches state electric power corporation.
newsitem.headline: China launches state electric power corporation.

text.p: China has launched a state electric power corporation to take responsibility for inter-regional electricity supply and unify management of the national power network, the Financial News said on Saturday.
The company was formally created in Beijing on Thursday and would be funded and controlled by the State Council, or cabinet, the newspaper said.

It quoted Vice Premier Wu Bangguo as saying the creation of the new company was part of the continuing reform of the national power industry, which in recent years has struggled to keep pace with the demands of China's booming economy.
The Ministry of Power Industry should move to clarify the tasks and responsibilities of the ministry, the power network and the new corporation, the newspaper quoted Wu as saying but gave no details.
Work to set up the new company was expected to be completed by the end of June this year, the China Securities newspaper said in a separate report.
